query:
WITH admin AS (
            INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role)
            SELECT $1, $2, 'admin'
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users)
            RETURNING id
        ), audit AS (
            INSERT INTO audit_events (action, target_user_id)
            SELECT 'user.bootstrap', id FROM admin
        )
        SELECT count(*) AS "created!" FROM admin
